title: Encoded but Exposed: Language Embeddings can Reveal More Than They Should in Recommender Systems
abstract: arXiv:2610.21713v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Language embeddings are increasingly used in recommenders to represent item content, but their privacy risks remain poorly understood. We study whether item embeddings can reveal item identities when an adversary has access to auxiliary item text from external sources. We show that a simple cosine-similarity attack can recover item identities with high mean reciprocal rank across language models and candidate-set settings on two real-world datasets. Leakage is strongest when the adversary's partial information overlaps with the victim representation, but it also persists through semantic alignment between independently sourced descriptions. We further show that item leakage can propagate to user re-identification from sparse ratings. Finally, we evaluate obfuscated descriptions as a mitigation and find a clear leakage-utility tradeoff.

translated_title: 虽经编码却暴露无遗：语言嵌入在推荐系统中的信息泄露超乎想象
translated_abstract: 语言嵌入在推荐系统中被越来越多地用于表示物品内容，但其隐私风险仍然鲜为人知。我们研究了当攻击者能够获取来自外部来源的辅助物品文本时，物品嵌入是否会泄露物品身份。我们证明，在两个真实世界数据集上，一种简单的余弦相似度攻击能够在不同语言模型和候选集设置下，以较高的平均倒数排名（MRR）恢复物品身份。当攻击者的部分信息与受害者的表示重叠时，泄露最为严重；即使描述来自独立来源，泄露仍可通过语义对齐而持续存在。我们进一步表明，物品泄露可以传播并导致基于稀疏评分的用户再识别。最后，我们评估了使用混淆描述作为缓解手段，并发现存在明显的泄露-效用权衡。
tldr: 该研究揭示了推荐系统中的语言嵌入存在严重隐私风险——简单的余弦相似度攻击即可高精度恢复物品身份，泄露还可进一步传播导致用户再识别，而以混淆描述作为防御手段则面临明显的泄露-效用权衡。
en_tdlr: This study reveals serious privacy risks in recommender systems: a simple cosine-similarity attack can recover item identities from language embeddings with high accuracy, the leakage further propagates to user re-identification from sparse ratings, and obfuscated descriptions as a mitigation face a clear leakage-utility tradeoff.
